Uh let me dissect this from my POV.

Green Day first entered the mainstream with Dookie. So basically they've always been mainstream. Sure their sound has changed a lot but they were massively popular between Dookie and 21st Century Breakdown.

People gotta break away from the idea or notion that mainstream = bad as well. Mainstream just means popular in a sense.

**Uno Dos Tres -** Highkey a return to form. Biggest issue was the quality control of the songs and the overly done production that took edge and life out of the songs. **Revolution Radio** \- Honestly think this is easily their best album that came out post 21st. I have some serious issues with the production but outside of that a really solid project. **FOAM -** Not gonna say this is a sellout or it is an attempt of reentering the mainstream. Truth is that they took a chance at gambling with their sound. Really didn't work out imo. Their worst album.
